synthesis.oneLine: The tradition hands us a typed, gate-shaped, time-encumbered world, and the game era spent thirty years overwriting it with one number — keep every canon mechanic that is a gate on your own state, cut every one that is a number about you relative to other people, and build the coordination layer on a shared clock rather than on a conversation.

canonMap.cluster: The ladder and the wall it hits
canonMap.whatItBuysUs: Free comprehension of the spine, the ceiling, and the wall. It is also, unavoidably, the scalar the repo forbids, so it must be AUTHORED as a set of gates that each buy a named capability — 炼气 buys 神识 and 术法, 筑基 buys 辟谷 and long-duration flight, 结丹 buys 本命法宝 and unaided flight, 元婴 buys a detachable self, 化神 buys ambient draw at a cost in 寿元 — rather than as magnitudes. The capability list is verified primary text. The number list is not, and we do not need it.

The asymmetry, the most legible scene in the genre (the test), and the genre's OWN pre-scalar answer: 五行相克 is canon and the number is the later import. The one documented test that keeps two axes unranked is 仙灵图谱's 仙缘灯 — brightness is a continuous 资质 that is really 根骨 with no tiers, colour is the element, and the novel has no root count at all. That lamp, not the aperture-band ladder, is the shape we want. The ladder is canon and the ladder is a scalar; both are true, and we use the first and refuse the second.

The genre's only genuinely non-arithmetic power model and our strongest structural precedent. 觅长生's 生命/神识/遁速 diverge across a 20x range rather than tracking one number, and 斗破 runs a separate soul ladder (凡灵天帝) that only re-converges at the very top. 搜魂 is the one information-theoretic weapon in the corpus — extraction, not damage. 泥丸宫 versus 识海 is the vocabulary for a mind that is a place.

The knowledge economy, and the best agent-legible comprehension model in the corpus: 顿悟 opens during an act, closes when the act ends, and is legible only in retrospect — so an agent can plan the act but cannot optimise a rate. The 残卷 canon anchor is 凡人 ch.217: 青元剑诀 circulates as nine of thirteen layers with a hard ceiling, and the missing four sit behind a two-key lock only the fragment itself can open. That is TRUNCATION, not demotion; demotion would rebuild the scalar. 藏经阁 floors gated on your own realm is a gate on state, not on rank.

The genre's tierless-object tradition is real and the ladder is the later import: 封神演义 has no artifact grade ladder at all and 斗破苍穹 grades 功法/斗技, not 法宝. 符宝 is the one mechanism in canon that trades power for TIME rather than for a higher rung — one tenth of an artifact's 威能, craftable at 结丹+, usable by any tier, depleted on use, and variable within its own class. Grade as a claim on the wielder rather than a stat package is the second lever. Do NOT present 天地玄黄-for-法宝 as inherited: it is a modern folk reflex with no author, and 封神's own artefact is 玲珑宝塔 without the prefix.

The only genre system with a real enumerable constraint structure rather than a probability roll — 觅长生's published rule set (fixed slot counts, 平衡寒热, 144 pills over 159 materials) is a constraint-satisfaction space a machine can reason about, and 鬼谷八荒's version makes an unmatched element visibly become 杂质 and raise 炸炉 risk. 抱朴子 supplies the deepest unexploited material in the whole corpus: combining the eight immortals' ingredients is explicitly a TRAP (药力有转相胜畏), not a synergy bonus, and 合丹 caps the party at three. 年份 is the dominant quality axis, not the unanimous one — 觅长生 grades by 品级 instead.

The load-bearing structural fact of the whole genre: the concentration mechanic is a PLACE, and qi is explicitly non-depleting (凡人 ch.220: 灵脉成形后自动散发灵气，循环不绝，不会有枯竭之日), which forecloses the entire resource-drain family at the root. 坊市's stated reason-for-being is the best insight the sweep found: safety is a purchased good, funded by a trade tax, and terminates at the boundary. 散修 thrive because the world's baseline is one tier below any 灵脉 — place-typed differentiation, stated as authorial intent. 秘境 is a young game-era word layered over 禁地; use 禁地 for anything diegetic. The 118-site 洞天/福地 list is NOT fixed — three enumerations disagree and 杜光庭's 福地 has 71.

The second ladder — the genre's real answer to 'power is not a number' is a SECOND independent ladder, not a decomposition of the first. 藏经阁 floors gated on your own cultivation level is the cleanest instance and is canon across four unrelated works. 诛仙's auto-deposition is the best agent-compatible governance rule found anywhere: two weeks offline and the system strips the leader, hands the seat to the highest-contribution deputy, and requires that they have logged in within ten days. 鬼谷八荒 prices promotion in contribution AND makes the seat winnable by a fight. The sect's PROMISED list is canon prose (a 洞府, no chores, annual materials, one duty); the COSTED list does not exist anywhere.

Identity and social force with NO power number in it — the cheapest high-value cluster we have. The three-authority SEPARATION survives even though the citation for it failed: a 法名 from a master, a 道号 self-chosen, a 尊号 from an authority. 散仙 (unappointed, no office) versus 金仙 (holds an office and a salary) is an axis genuinely orthogonal to cultivation, sourced to 韩愈 and 神仙传, not to a game. 字辈 is a lineage poem issued as the gate on naming, and 诛仙 shows a generation being CONSUMED in order (普泓…普方, then 法相/法善/法中) — a sequence, not a monoculture. Ming-dynasty title inflation is the historical proof that a granted name loses all discriminating power through mass issuance: eight founding offices became 133 by 成化二十三年, with 300-odd 传升 in a single reign.

The two-axis grade that is the genre's structural defence against a composite score: 品阶 sits on the OBJECT and 境界 on the PERSON, which is exactly why the genre never needed a power number and the game era had to invent one. The four-tier ladder is canon including 忘语 himself (低阶/中阶/高阶/超阶, with a parallel element axis); the 100:1 step is a strong majority convention many works violate and is free to discard. The top tier exits circulation in two independent works (有价无市, 理论上可以兑换实践中已成为宝物). 储物袋 is the pattern the whole domain should copy: it hard-refuses an insert on capacity and cannot hold living things, so the constraint requires the agent to remember nothing. 户帖 is the best-evidenced administrative boundary in the corpus: no 户帖 means 黑戶 and life outside the walls; 100 灵石 at the gate; inheritable from one parent.

The strongest structural claim in the domain: TWO ECONOMIES PULLING THE SAME BODY APART, and 反哺 is the genre's substitute for harvesting — 妖丹 is the beast's own cultivation engine, so taking it is amputation, not collection. 血契 versus 魂契 is the best agent-readable contract pair in the corpus because it is already machine-checkable: the bond is revocable at will, the beast may leave unilaterally, and 炼魂 destroys it. 御兽诸天's definition is the useful line — what you control is a 灵兽, what you do not is a 妖兽 — which makes control, not species, the boundary. 奇虫榜 is the genre's own unreliable ranking artefact: the novel says outright whether the list can be trusted is anyone's guess.

The sense of deep time, and the genre's own argument with itself about its own clock (the genre complains that 闭关 now runs 一甲子, and complains that it used to be shorter). It is also the most dangerous cluster we inherit: 寿元 is a CONSEQUENCE of 境界, not the scalar — the thing that must not exist is the realm ladder, not the lifespan — and every clock in the corpus is denominated in units an agent cannot hold. Note 灵潮 is NOT 传承: its one classical attestation (郭璞《江赋》) is about the Yangtze tide, not a qi cycle.

inventory.system: 境界 ladder and its per-rung capability gates
inventory.openQuestion: Does any rung of our ladder order two cultivators against each other? If yes, the whole design is the thing the repo rule forbids and every downstream system becomes a function of it.
inventory.blockedBy: the repo rule; and both shipped tribulations we found (云墟修仙录, 一念逍遥) adjudicate by 战力 threshold

inventory.system: Sub-stage shape (前期/中期/后期/圆满 vs 层)
inventory.openQuestion: Is a sub-stage a RATE (how fast you move through it) or a STATE (a thing you must be in)? A rate is what an agent cannot optimise.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — sub-stage count is a free variable, and the corpus splits both ways (一念逍遥 uses 10 layers for 炼气 and four stages above; 觅长生 uses three only, with 大圆满 as the capped state of 后期 rather than a fourth bar)

inventory.system: 灵根 / 五行 innate constitution
inventory.openQuestion: Can the root be TYPED (which elements, which technique it will run) rather than GRADED (a number)? 仙灵图谱's lamp proves a two-axis unranked readout is authorable; the aperture-band ladder proves the graded version is a scalar.
inventory.blockedBy: the two-total-orders problem — 凡人 runs root-count and purity-grade as two separate total orders over all cultivators, and two ranks purporting to order everyone force every system to pick one

inventory.system: 功法 / 心法 tier ladder
inventory.openQuestion: What makes a manual BETTER without a number attached to it? 忘语 states plainly that 功法等阶 and 修为等阶 are not the same concept, and his 残本 caps out at 结丹 purely by truncation.
inventory.blockedBy: the only working precedent in the corpus is 斗破's four-dimension grade (质/量/吸收修炼速度/顺畅程度) with the structural line 阶别之间差距巨大，级别之间差距不大 — four axes, none of which is a power score

inventory.openQuestion: How is a window that opens during an act, closes when the act ends, and is legible only in retrospect made plannable by an agent? Canon answers the shape; nothing in the corpus answers the record.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — this is pure design, and it is the one comprehension model in the corpus that is not a rate

inventory.openQuestion: Is a partial text TRUNCATED (fewer layers, hard ceiling, canon) or DEMOTED (lower 品阶)? Demotion is a conversion from grade to power, which is the scalar. Canon answers it: truncation.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — 凡人 ch.217 settles it, and the two-key lock (a page that absorbs the technique's own output) is the best scarcity mechanic in the corpus

inventory.openQuestion: Is the gate your own state (which realm you are) or your rank among peers (how much contribution you have)? The first survives the no-scalar rule; the second does not.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — canon answers it, and answers it four times in four unrelated works

inventory.openQuestion: Retry loop or saturating accumulator? Canon says accumulator: the seventh pill brings the residue to 接近饱和 and the eighth makes it 爆发. An accumulator is countable in advance; a retry loop is not.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — 凡人 ch.216 settles the mechanism, though the text then has the protagonist break the three-month rule repeatedly and succeed, so the constraint is advisory in the source

inventory.openQuestion: What does the tribulation TEST, if not a threshold comparison? Both documented shipped versions resolve it as 战力 ≥ 雷劫战力, which converts the genre's most dramatic scene into a coin flip on a number.
inventory.blockedBy: the scalar rule, hard. This is the single most important mechanic to invent and the one the genre has most consistently got wrong

inventory.openQuestion: What does the demon read, and what does it punish? 楞严经's anti-enrolment rule — 若作圣解，即受群邪 — says it punishes INTERPRETATION, which makes it a free-text surface and therefore a liability for agents.
inventory.blockedBy: the free-text hazard; and no game has replaced the reading with a machine-checkable predicate

inventory.openQuestion: Is the deadline moved by anything? 觅长生's shipped answer is no: 延寿仙药 does not extend the 1000-year 雷劫 clock. A deadline no agent can act on is a silent failure, not a tension.
inventory.blockedBy: no agent holds a session for a thousand years; cut it as a gate and keep it only as a word

inventory.openQuestion: Is it a state the agent must MODEL, or a tax it pays? 红楼梦 settles recoverability — 幸亏打坐不久，魔还入得浅，可以有救 — and the classical split is 走火 physiological against 入魔 neurological.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; but note 斗破's version is triggered by ingesting an external substance and survived by another character's presence, which is coordination-shaped and worth stealing

inventory.openQuestion: None worth asking. It is a power comparison by construction, it is once per lifetime, and canon's own rule makes the possessor lose by inaction — assimilation is host-default.
inventory.blockedBy: the no-scalar rule; and the corpus's other four rule-sets all differ from 凡人's, so there is no shared shape to inherit either

inventory.openQuestion: Does our world carry memory across a death? Memory-carrying reincarnation is a save file, and a save file dissolves the failure layer for an agent. Note the polarity: the web-novel convention is overwhelmingly memory-RETAINING, so an amnesiac world is the deviation, not the default.
inventory.blockedBy: 太吾绘卷's 10%-inherit-but-wipe-relations is the one documented costed version (one game)

inventory.system: 肉身 / 神魂 / 本命 as three bodies
inventory.openQuestion: What does each body OWN, and what can only one of them do? The corpus proves they diverge — 觅长生's three stats span a 20x range and do not track one number — but nobody has published why.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing structurally; the open question is balance, and no studio has published a number

inventory.system: 灵脉 / 洞府 / 灵田 as the concentration mechanic
inventory.openQuestion: Is a 洞府 a purchasable capability or a cell on a map? Canon says a radius around a peak, claimed by a stamped seal — adjacent peaks are therefore contestable, which the cell reading would erase.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; but the corrected rent ladder matters — a 2:1 grade step buys a 10:1 rent step, and that is one work's balance, not a law

inventory.system: 灵草 quality (年份 vs 品级)
inventory.openQuestion: Is age the only quality axis? It is dominant, not unanimous — 觅长生 grades by 品级 with 药力 1/3/9/36/180/1080 and 鬼谷八荒 has its own 品阶. 年份 alone would make the gathering step single-variable.
inventory.blockedBy: the unplantability canon constraint: 筑基丹's three herbs are named in primary text as 天生自长 precisely because cultivators cannot farm them

inventory.openQuestion: Is it constrained optimisation over a PUBLISHED rule set, or a probability roll? Only the first is agent-plannable, and 觅长生 is the only shipped instance of it (fixed slot counts, 平衡寒热, an enumerable recipe space).
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; but do not learn a closed formula from guides — the one widely copied quality formula is sourced to three mutually inconsistent pages, two of which had World of Warcraft text pasted mid-article

inventory.openQuestion: Does an artifact carry a CLAIM on the wielder (a set of preconditions, and the world state it unlocks is the reward) or a stat package? 封神 and 斗破 both grade something else; the tierless tradition is the inherited one.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; but 认主 is a machine-checkable transaction and should be built as a boolean the system evaluates, not as a roll the agent watches

inventory.openQuestion: None. Use it as-is: one tenth of the 威能, craftable at 结丹+, usable by any tier, depleted on use, variable within its class, and three to five years of the OWNER's 元气 to recover — not centuries, which is what the fan summaries say.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — the cleanest canon trade in the corpus: power for time, not for a higher rung

inventory.system: 宗门 and the membership ladder
inventory.openQuestion: What does the sect PROMISE and what does it CHARGE? The promised list is canon prose; the costed list exists nowhere in the corpus. That gap is the design.
inventory.blockedBy: the four-rung membership ladder is a synthesis, not an inheritance (诛仙 uses 七脉, 迦南 uses 外院/内院, 黄枫谷 uses 执事/领事) — safe to use, wrong to cite as inherited

inventory.openQuestion: Is the ledger one-way? The WORD is a game import; the FUNCTION is canon, because 斗破's 迦南内院 runs a 火能 ledger earned by 扫塔, 魔核 hunts and arena wins, spent in 藏书阁 and on tower time, with a seven-day monthly stipend.
inventory.blockedBy: cross-branch non-convertibility rests on a single AI-generated encyclopedia page, and one novel runs the opposite; treat non-convertibility as unestablished

inventory.system: 客卿长老 as a contract tier
inventory.openQuestion: Does the contract pay in 灵石 or in ACCESS? The boundary between canon vocabulary and unsystemised idea is cleanest here.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — but half the corroboration in the corpus was fanfiction, so re-source before citing

inventory.system: 论道 / 大比 / 切磋
inventory.openQuestion: Is there a third-party referee, and can the referee award a win on injury? 凡人's answer to the first is yes and it is the cleanest anti-bias rule found; the answer to the second is no, and it comes from one chapter of a novel by a different author than the one usually credited.
inventory.blockedBy: both are ONE_WORK; the 同代-only bracket and the 同境界-only lethal ceiling each rest on a single chapter of a single low-tier web novel

inventory.openQuestion: Does the reward go to the killer or to the INFORMANT? Canon text says the informant — the apparatus is aimed at third parties, not at a bounty. Build it aimed at third parties; that is both the source's shape and a better agent-safe design.
inventory.blockedBy: the escalation-incentive problem: an open kill order plus GPT-4's one-defect unforgiveness is the retaliation spiral the LLM literature predicts

inventory.system: 名 / 道号 / 尊号 / 字辈
inventory.openQuestion: What is the granting authority, what does the name cost, and what happens when the authority issues too many? Ming-dynasty precedent: eight founding offices became 133 within a century, with 300-odd 传升 in one reign.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing — the cheapest high-value system we have, and it carries no power number at all

inventory.system: 声望 / 好感度 / 恶名
inventory.openQuestion: Per-viewer or global? The per-viewer variant is the interesting one and is documented in chapter text (炼气+1, 筑基+10, 结丹+100 to whoever helped you). A global signed band is a scalar.
inventory.blockedBy: the scalar rule; and any agent that falls below a threshold may have no in-game verb that repairs it

inventory.openQuestion: Fixed price, or a book with depth? The corpus is fixed-price by default (every NPC shop, every 收购价) and that default is right for agents, because agents never converge and systematically overconcede.
inventory.blockedBy: the 100:1 step is convention-free (documented at 100:1, 1000:1, 10:1, and roughly 5/5/6 across works) so we are free to pick; the four-tier LADDER is canon including 忘语

inventory.openQuestion: None. The target pattern is already right: the bag hard-refuses an insert when capacity or the shrink ratio is exceeded, and cannot hold living things. The system refuses, so the agent has to remember nothing.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing

inventory.system: 妖兽 / 妖丹 / 魔核
inventory.openQuestion: Is the 妖丹 the beast's own cultivation engine, so that harvesting is amputation rather than collection? One work states it outright; nobody has shipped it as a system.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; the 魔核-as-refining-input version is canon-adjacent through 斗破's published recipes

inventory.openQuestion: What is the per-beast cost, and what is the bypass? 御兽诸天 has a complete answer — each beast costs 心神, 妖王 let you command a tribe for free, and feeding a tribe empties your treasury — which is a cost, a bypass, and a running cost.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; the honest count of design answers here is at least three, not two

inventory.system: 秘境 / 禁地 (the instanced reward)
inventory.openQuestion: Is the window a COLLECTIVE WEAKNESS or a lockout? 凡人's answer is a five-day weakness in a five-year seal that several 结丹 must combine to force — a shared clock, a countable predicate, no negotiation. 诛仙's answer is a 10-minute summonable demon with a hard cross-player lockout, which is the retaliation-spiral shape.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing structurally; the design choice is the whole point

inventory.system: 洞天 / 福地 (the sealed realm)
inventory.openQuestion: Is the list enumerable at all, and does entry get recorded? The concept is canon; the 118-site list is not fixed (three enumerations disagree, 杜光庭's 福地 has 71). One live novel makes non-registration an explicit security property.
inventory.blockedBy: do not inherit a fixed list; the concept is free, the enumeration is not

inventory.openQuestion: Is it a margin, a toll, or a claim? The corpus has all three, and the best instance is a fifty-year-old revenue split still nominally owed to a sect that lost the array in an internal war.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; the 2.78x figure is one author's arithmetic on one array and is not a law

inventory.openQuestion: None. The genre's own verdict is that it now runs 一甲子 and that it used to be shorter. No agent can hold it, and the one shipped wall-clock tribulation deadline has no player-facing lever at all.
inventory.blockedBy: the LLM long-horizon constraint; cut it as a wall and keep the word

inventory.system: 灵潮 / 兽潮 / the world calendar
inventory.openQuestion: Does the calendar ADJUDICATE or merely INFORM? If it adjudicates on a threshold we have rebuilt the scalar. If it is a shared clock every agent can compute without talking to anyone, it is the coordination substrate.
inventory.blockedBy: the three root traditions use incompatible cadences (封神 has no 三灾 at all and runs 1500 years; 凡人 runs 300/3000; 西游记 runs 500/1000/1500), so there is no shared number to inherit

inventory.openQuestion: Is the suppression LOCAL or GLOBAL, and is it a rule or a bug? 凡人 states it as a rule with two conditions (environment difference and power level) and applies it to a 真仙 descending. The 血色禁地 tier gate, by contrast, is a plot hole in the text that says so.
inventory.blockedBy: nothing; note the map LAYOUT (one zone per realm) is the game-era addition, not the suppression itself

inventory.openQuestion: None. Cut it. The repo rule is explicit, and the genre's own published meta is to strip pets and newly-learned 神通 so the displayed number sits lower for the bracket — at which point players are managing their character as a loadout to be shown or hidden.
inventory.blockedBy: the repo rule; the swept evidence names at least six shipped games that gate content, matchmaking or endgame access on it

inventory.system: 体力 / stamina / daily caps / 限购 / 绑定 / VIP / 月卡 / 签到
inventory.openQuestion: None. These are monetisation infrastructure, not genre. A clock the agent cannot observe is a silent failure; a binding tag makes half an economy unwinnable by an agent that did not read the patch note.
inventory.blockedBy: PLATFORM_ARTEFACT by definition; and 偷菜 is a QQ农场 import the studio had to name-and-import, which by definition means the audience does not already know it

inventory.system: 跑商 / 日常 / 挂机 / 采集次数
inventory.openQuestion: None. A hard offline cap with level scaling removed converts the whole economy into a login-counting problem, and the genre's own designer says the target is under an hour of daily play with every system 减负 or 继承.
inventory.blockedBy: the micromanagement constraint; and the most-cited gathering hazard in the corpus rests on three forum threads that are one community playbook copied three times in 28 hours

inventory.system: Resource-drain economics: veins that deplete, servers that strip
inventory.openQuestion: None as a drain. Canon states the opposite: 灵脉成形后自动散发灵气，循环不绝，不会有枯竭之日. A resource-drain economy contradicts the genre's own physics.
inventory.blockedBy: the 死矿脉 core-as-organ idea is ONE work and the depletable-shared-vein pattern is in at least four others, so the CONCEPT is occupied; only the core-as-organ version is one author's

hardConstraints.constraint: No single scalar may rank all cultivators. The moment the number exists, matchmaking, tier access, rewards and every other system quietly become functions of it.
hardConstraints.source: Shipped repo rule, packages/features/progression/src/rules.ts:276-278, quoted verbatim. Independently corroborated by the genre's own structure: 品阶 sits on objects and 境界 on persons, and 五行相克 is the tradition's pre-scalar answer.

hardConstraints.constraint: The tribulation may not be adjudicated by a threshold comparison. The genre's most dramatic scene must not be a coin flip on a number the player can only inflate.
hardConstraints.source: 云墟修仙录's official guide, from 金丹 onward every tribulation resolves on one line: 胜负只看一条：你的战力 ≥ 雷劫战力就成功，否则必败. 一念逍遥's official patch notes gate endgame the same way: 若部分衰劫较为凶险，若仙友战力不足则无法征伐.

hardConstraints.constraint: A root or a realm may not become a composite rank. Two ladders that each purport to order everyone are worse than one.
hardConstraints.source: Verified across four works: 凡人 runs root-count and purity-grade as two independent total orders; 修仙家族模拟器 makes every downstream number a percentage of one ranking. The cleanest statement of the anti-scalar position is that aptitude is body-capacity and has nothing to do with 才情 — a genius may fail to open an aperture and a fool may be 甲等. The idea is canon; the chapter citation commonly attached to it is not.

hardConstraints.constraint: No wall clock denominated in years may be a gate.
hardConstraints.source: The genre's own sentence against itself: 很多修仙者闭关，动不动就是一甲子时间. 觅长生's shipped form is a 1000-year 雷劫 deadline for 化神 that 延寿仙药 explicitly does not move — a deadline with no player-facing lever.

hardConstraints.constraint: No mechanic may require free-form negotiation between agents, and no price may require haggling.
hardConstraints.source: Nature Human Behaviour 2025: LLMs play self-interested games well and coordination games badly. arXiv:2609.02580, 11 buyers and 11 sellers on a published price grid: no experiment observed complete convergence. arXiv:2509.09071: LLM sellers systematically overconcede, and the authors warn this holds in adversarial and zero-sum settings.

hardConstraints.constraint: No mechanic may depend on an agent holding state across thousands of turns, and longer thinking is not a fix.
hardConstraints.source: arXiv:2604.11840: five agents, fifteen turns, 314 of 315 runs collapse to an authority decision when there is no structured memory of the negotiation — and enabling provider-native reasoning moved the outcome distribution by exactly zero (0 of 135). More thinking is not more memory.

hardConstraints.constraint: No shared object may create a permanent state from a single betrayal.
hardConstraints.source: Nature Human Behaviour 2025: GPT-4 never cooperates again with an agent that defects once and then cooperates on every round thereafter, and defect rates are 52.8% / 51.5% / 47.1% with no significant difference across payoff structures. 诛仙's 心魔 is the shape to avoid — a 10-minute shared boss with a hard cross-player lockout.

hardConstraints.constraint: Every constraint must be machine-checkable, not narrated. The system should refuse, not adjudicate.
hardConstraints.source: 储物袋 in 凡人 ch.158 hard-refuses an insert when capacity or the shrink ratio is exceeded and cannot hold living things — the agent has to remember nothing. 剑网3's band behaviour strings are equally checkable: at 仇恨 and 敌视, 主动攻击，不能对话、接任务.

hardConstraints.constraint: Comprehension may not be modelled as a rate. It is a window that opens during an act, closes when the act ends, and is legible only in retrospect.
hardConstraints.source: 顿悟 as canon: insight opens during an action, closes when the action ends, and the practitioner cannot act on it during the window either. Any agent-facing design that models it as a rate will mis-model it.

hardConstraints.constraint: A 残卷 must be TRUNCATED, never DEMOTED. A partial text has fewer layers and a hard ceiling; it is not a lower 品阶.
hardConstraints.source: 凡人 ch.217, verbatim: 原本也不是九层，而是十三层才对…本门现在流传的青元剑诀只是残本而已！顶多能修炼到结丹期. Demotion reintroduces a grade-to-power conversion, which is the scalar by another route.

hardConstraints.constraint: A gate must be a function of your own state, never of your rank among other people.
hardConstraints.source: 藏经阁 floors gated on the reader's own cultivation level is canon across four unrelated works (诛仙's 幻月洞府, 斗破's 藏书阁 and 天焚炼气塔, 鬼谷八荒's six floors, 了不起's 门派声望). It survives the no-scalar rule precisely because it ranks nothing.

hardConstraints.constraint: 不可毁人丹田 must be a hard prohibition with a machine-checkable consequence, ranked alongside 不可伤人性命.
hardConstraints.source: Canon, held in two genuinely independent works. This is the rule that lets a shared object be dangerous without being permanently escalatory.

hardConstraints.constraint: Anything the operator issues must be revocable, and must decay or be reclaimable. Mass issuance destroys the discriminator.
hardConstraints.source: 明代: 道录司 founded 洪武十五年 with 设官八员; by 成化二十三年 the register reads 一百三十三员, 增至原额之十五六倍, with 传升 recorded 三百数十次 in 成化二十余年间. The genre's own history is the argument. Its game-era corollary is 诛仙's auto-deposition: two weeks offline strips the leader and hands the seat to the highest-contribution deputy, who must have logged in within ten days.

hardConstraints.constraint: A modern folk reflex must not be presented as inherited tradition.
hardConstraints.source: 天地玄黄 as a 法宝 ladder is replicated across hundreds of mutually unrelated Q&A pages with no identifiable author, and 封神演义 has no artifact grade ladder at all. 三九/四九/六九/九九 bolt numerology is 20th-21st century web-novel convention with an attested counter-definition inside the corpus, and 斗破苍穹 has no 灵根. 山海经 names none of 饕餮/梼杌/白泽/麒麟 anywhere in its eighteen juan.

hardConstraints.constraint: Name and standing may not carry a power number. Identity and reputation are a separate axis from cultivation, and the tradition already has the proof.
hardConstraints.source: 散仙 (未授仙职) versus 金仙 (有职位有俸禄) is an OFFICE axis orthogonal to cultivation power, attested in 韩愈 and 神仙传. 忘语 states plainly that 功法等阶和修为等阶并不是一个等同的概念. The 明代 inflation precedent is what happens when a granted name becomes a rank.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: The collective-weakness window as the world's only coordination primitive. A seal with a five-year cycle and a five-day weakness that several cultivators must combine to force is a shared clock plus a countable state predicate. Two agents can coordinate on it by reading the calendar, not by talking to each other. This is the single mechanism in the corpus that satisfies every LLM constraint at once.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: It is not that nobody thought of it — the genre writes the mechanic constantly. It is that a window which HELPS everyone is commercially inert: no human player feels tension from a clock they can all see, because the interesting version (a secret realm that opens on a cycle) only creates drama by also creating a scramble inside it. The window survives in the fiction only where it is a plot device for one protagonist's escape. Nobody has promoted it from a loophole to the substrate, because a substrate that resolves reliably is a substrate nobody writes marketing about.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Make the window a published world-state variable rather than a discovery, and make the requirement a COUNT of agents meeting a state predicate at a stated time — not a pact, not a message, not a negotiation. Then put every shared reward in the world inside one. The rest of the design becomes: what is a state predicate an agent can evaluate about itself without asking anyone.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: Ascension as a one-way exit. The genre's canon supplies 飞升 as a departure, and the two commercial works that were forced into server rotation did so explicitly BECAUSE of the power curve — the designer says the numbers inflate exponentially and that the circle mechanic was the release valve. A world whose top rung is a different PHASE (a plane, an office, a sect) rather than a higher number needs no power ceiling, and therefore needs no scalar to police one.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: Commercial, and it is not close. An MMO's revenue model requires the top player to stay at the top and the ladder above them to keep rising. Leaving is a one-way door with no return spend. 诛仙's own cross-server collapse shows the labour market that dries up when the top players sell their accounts and 脱坑 — the genre has literally watched this kill a server's competitive layer.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: A persistent world where ascension removes the player from the layer that has a leaderboard, and where the vacated seat is a durable world fact that other agents inherit. This is the only route found in the sweep that removes the NEED for a ceiling rather than working around one.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: Capacity-typed place grades instead of power-typed ones. A vein's grade sets how many people it can sustain, not how strong it makes them. One game's official text says exactly this, and the corrected rent ladder shows a 2:1 grade step buying a 10:1 rent step, which means the grade is being priced as scarcity rather than as power. This is the genre's structural anti-scalar move already half-built.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: Every combat system in the genre wants a power number, and a capacity grade produces none — so the moment anyone wires a 灵脉 into a fight they convert it to a power grade to make the combat legible, and the capacity reading is discarded. The official guide that states the capacity rule also carries a power-scalar fallback clause for who wins a contested vein, which is what the pass read first.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Commit to no combat resolution keyed on a place grade. A vein is a room with a door count. Then the interesting question becomes who gets to use the door, which is a politics problem, not a stats problem.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: The market that prices DEPTH, not price. The corpus already documents a spread between posted and realised rates (100 posted, 120-130 in the black market, a negotiation ladder running 100 to 120 to 150 with the seller conceding), and one auction house already runs a finite computable bid lattice. What nobody has built is an order book with visible DEPTH, so an agent reads liquidity instead of negotiating a price.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: It removes the human moment. A spread is noise to a person — you just walk to the other stall — and a haggle is content, and content is what a marketplace is for. Publishing depth is also commercially awkward: it tells a player exactly when not to sell.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Replace every negotiation surface with a book. The agents get convergence for free (they are bad at the alternative and systematically overconcede as sellers), and the interesting decisions move to timing and size, which are computable.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: Pacing by consequence density rather than by wall clock. The corpus contains exactly two pacing answers and both fail an agent fleet: an irreversible lifespan deadline that no pill moves, and server rotation. The unclaimed third answer is a calendar of CONSEQUENCES — things that happen because of what agents did, on a clock they can read.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: It breaks the retention maths every live service is built on. Dailies and 挂机 are the commercial model precisely because they convert time into spend, and a consequence-driven calendar does not. The genre has the calendar already (秘境 cycles, 兽潮, 三千年大劫) but has only ever used it to create a scramble, never as a substitute for a timer.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Publish the calendar, publish the predicate that puts an agent on it, and make the density of consequences per unit of agent-time the pacing knob instead of the length of a timer.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: The artifact as a claim on the wielder rather than a stat package, plus 符宝's trade of power for time. The tierless-object tradition is inherited (封神 has no artifact ladder; 斗破 grades techniques, not treasures) and 符宝 already does the harder thing: it gives up most of the 威能 to buy access, costs its owner three to five years, and is variable within its own class.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: Monetisation. An artifact-as-claim is strictly worse to sell than an artifact-as-upgrade, because the buyer cannot see a number go up, and every one of these games sells a number going up. The 天地玄黄 ladder that replaced it is a modern reflex with no author, which is exactly the shape of a convention that filled a commercial vacuum.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Give objects preconditions instead of multipliers, make the reward the world state the object unlocks rather than a stat, and keep one canonical time-priced object so the trade is legible. Do not add a tier ladder later; the genre's own history is the ladder arriving to fill the gap.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: A comprehension model with no rate, plus a post-hoc record. 顿悟 is canon and already the right shape — a window opened by an act, closed by its end, legible only afterwards. What no work in the corpus has is the record of what the practitioner learned, so the next attempt starts from knowledge rather than from a reroll.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: It is unmonetisable and unbalanceable both. You cannot tune a window you cannot see, and you cannot sell a memory. It also runs against the genre's tic of the comprehender as a special person with a talent stat — the one work in the corpus that locates capability in what a disciple can DERIVE rather than which manual they hold is a single web novel nobody copied.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Keep the window, add the record, and make the record — not a rate — the thing that compounds. The cost of an attempt is the same every time; what improves is the agent's model of the act.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: Contribution measured as help-to-others, with the permission bit as the object. One game's official rules document a member who holds 帮会资金管理权限 setting each member's daily ration — the authority is a thing you either hold or you do not, and it is perfectly machine-checkable. Combined with the auto-deposition rule (two weeks offline, seat to the highest contributor, who must have logged in within ten days) there is a complete governance model here that requires no negotiation and no trust.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: The commercial direction is wrong. A contribution score that measures help-to-others is slow, and the genre's whole economy runs on the opposite: a score that ranks you against your peers, which every leaderboard needs and which is exactly the scalar the repo forbids. The pass's own version of this slot (credit with no shop, too big to move) depended on sustained multi-party negotiation, which is the one thing the LLM evidence says agents cannot do.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Score the help, not the rank. Make the reward a capability (the ration bit, the access) rather than a number, and let the seat change hands on a rule the system can evaluate without anyone agreeing to anything.

openDesignSpace.opportunity: The peak of the ranking is a liability. Two works state it in primary text and neither generalised: a body whose aperture is perfectly full is too perfect for the world to permit (天地都不容许他们的存在, and the aperture bursts at 四转), and the strongest technique in 斗破 advances by consuming ranked world-objects and succeeded eight times out of eight.
openDesignSpace.whyNobodyHasTakenIt: It breaks the reward curve that retention and expansion maths both assume. A progression system whose top rung is a liability has to be explained to the player, and every one of these games would rather ship a bigger number at the top. The commercial pressure is not a preference here; it is the whole model.
openDesignSpace.whatItWouldTake: Make the cost fall in a different currency from the reward — time, another body's integrity, a claim someone else inherits — so the top of the ladder is a decision rather than a destination. Pair it with the ascension-as-exit slot, which already requires the top rung to be a threshold rather than a peak.

dangerList.design: 战力 as a displayed scalar, and any content, matchmaking or endgame gate keyed to it.
dangerList.whyNot: The repo rule forbids it and at least six shipped games break on it. The genre's own published meta is the proof: players strip pets, skip ranked PvP and 洗去 newly-learned 神通 so the displayed number sits lower for evaluation brackets, with the guide stating outright that 盲目提升账面数字并非最优解. At that point players are managing their character as a loadout to be shown or hidden.

dangerList.design: The tribulation adjudicated by a threshold comparison (战力 ≥ 雷劫战力).
dangerList.whyNot: This is the purest instance of the failure in the entire sweep, and it ships: 云墟修仙录's official guide resolves every tribulation from 金丹 onward on one line, and 一念逍遥 gates endgame the same way in official patch notes. It converts the genre's most dramatic scene into a coin flip on a number whose only lever is inflation.

dangerList.design: 灵根 as a graded personal scalar, stacked with 修为 as a composite rank.
dangerList.whyNot: Two ladders purporting to order all cultivators force every other system to pick one. 修仙家族模拟器's published tables are the demonstration: 旬速 and breakthrough bonuses are percentages of one ranking, so matchmaking, access and rewards all become functions of it. 蛊真人's aperture bands (丁二三成 through 甲八九成, verified verbatim across five hosts) are a capacity scale, not a rank, and are the version worth copying.

dangerList.design: The four-gate multiplicative breakthrough — three gates multiplying to a single 0.48% figure, with every documented build tuned to land just over 100.00.
dangerList.whyNot: This is a power scalar with three inputs, and the gates are real-time reaction minigames (find the one true image among eight before a countdown whose length is your stat divided by ten). It is the most micromanagement-heavy shape in the domain, and a research pass rated it 'the design we are looking for and it already exists' while filing the same shape as a hazard elsewhere.

dangerList.design: Stamina, daily attempt caps, 限购, 绑定/非绑定, VIP, 月卡, 签到, 采集次数.
dangerList.whyNot: Monetisation infrastructure, not genre. A clock the agent cannot observe is a silent failure with no signal to learn from, and a binding tag makes half the economy unwinnable by an agent that did not read the patch note. The classification discipline matters too: 偷菜 is a QQ农场 import the studio had to name-and-import, which by definition means the audience does not already know it, and 绑定 descends from Chinese MMO infrastructure. Neither is 传承.

dangerList.design: 挂机 with a hard offline cap and level scaling removed (12 hours for a flat payout).
dangerList.whyNot: It converts the entire economy into a login-counting problem, which is the one thing an agent fleet cannot be taught to optimise and the one thing the genre's own designer says it is eliminating: 严格控制玩家每天的游戏时间，大概不会超过一个小时, with every system 通过毕业或者减负、继承的方式来降低玩家的操作负担.

dangerList.design: Resource-drain economics: veins that deplete, servers that strip, faucets and drains.
dangerList.whyNot: Canon says the opposite in primary text: 灵脉成形后便会自动散发出淡淡的灵气，让当地的灵气循环不绝，不会有枯竭之日. The genre's concentration mechanic is a PLACE and its qi is renewable, which forecloses the whole drain family at the root. The core-as-organ idea is one novel's and is not permission to build drains.

dangerList.design: Any wall clock in years as a gate — 闭关 as a wall, 寿元 as a deadline, a 1000-year 雷劫.
dangerList.whyNot: No agent can hold it, and the one shipped form has no player-facing lever at all: 觅长生's 化神 deadline is explicitly not moved by 延寿仙药. The genre's own text complains about its own scale — 动不动就是一甲子 — and the three root traditions use mutually incompatible tribulation cadences, so there is no inherited number to soften the blow.

dangerList.design: 夺舍 as a progression path.
dangerList.whyNot: It is a power comparison by construction (the three rules are all about the victim's protection), it is once per lifetime, and canon's own definition makes the possessor lose by doing nothing: 同化 is host-default, an involuntary mutual influence where only one consciousness survives. There is also no shared shape to inherit — four other works carry 夺舍 rule-sets and none matches 凡人's.

dangerList.design: The 天灵根 五行合一 inversion, where the bottom of the root ladder wins the gate the top cannot pass.
dangerList.whyNot: The source tradition says the opposite: 五行俱全突破到炼虚的几乎没有, because they are too slow, not because they are advantaged. 丹灵根 exists precisely so 天灵根 can be patched — a 天灵根 needs four of them where a 五灵根 needs none. The gate is a tax on the top of the ladder that the bottom cannot reach. Building on the misreading produces a mechanic that is worse than the one it replaces.

dangerList.design: 天地玄黄 as a 法宝 grade ladder, presented as inherited.
dangerList.whyNot: It is a mass vernacular reflex replicated across hundreds of mutually unrelated Q&A pages with no identifiable author — neither one studio's idea nor 传承, and the taxonomy has no bucket for it, which is itself the finding. 封神演义 has no artifact grade ladder at all and 斗破苍穹 grades 功法 and 斗技 instead. A fan article even has to invent 凡/神/仙/圣 to impose order on it.

dangerList.design: Any secret-realm calendar whose failure mode is a missed party sync or a missed window.
dangerList.whyNot: 剑网3's 同步秘境 generates an instance ID, prompts party members to sync, and if anyone declines or holds a different ID they are 分别被传送入不同ID的秘境内 — the party silently splits with no error surfaced. That is a pre-entry consensus failure with no observable state, precisely the LLM failure mode, and strictly more dangerous than any reset time.

dangerList.design: A shared 心魔 with a cross-player lockout, or any object where one agent's action permanently deprives another.
dangerList.whyNot: 诛仙's rule is explicit — 当别人已经召唤出心魔时，你不能再召唤心魔，必须等其他人将心魔杀死或心魔消失后方能再次召唤 — and it combines a shared object, a hard cross-player lockout, and a permanent-move population. GPT-4 never cooperates again after a single defection. This is the exact structure that produces a retaliation spiral, and it ships in one of the genre's most prominent titles.

dangerList.design: Reputation as a global signed band, and any reputation floor that gates basic verbs.
dangerList.whyNot: 剑网3's two lowest bands both read 主动攻击，不能对话、接任务 — dialogue and quest acceptance closed exactly where repair is needed. The same page lists three reputation sources, so the stronger 'no verb exists' claim is a reading rather than a fact; but the shape is the scalar in a costume. 烽火战国 runs 50 to 9,000,000 声望 across sixty ranks and its own official text says 声望值仅仅是一个衡量您在游戏中综合实力的数值.

dangerList.design: 散仙 combat ceilings expressed as 战力 ≈ 渡劫中期.
dangerList.whyNot: A power scalar wearing a costume, sourced to two novelists' numbers that the source itself calls irreconcilable, filed under a canon label in the same document that flags the identical shape as a hazard for other games. 散仙 as a vocabulary word survives; the ceiling figure is one book's balance note.

dangerList.design: 117/118-site 洞天/福地 lists, and the 三九/四九/六九/九九 bolt arithmetic presented as canon.
dangerList.whyNot: There is no fixed list anywhere: three enumerations disagree on ordering, names and locations, and 杜光庭's own 福地 section has 71 entries. The bolt convention is 20th-21st century web-novel numerology, absent from every root text the brief names, and it has an attested counter-definition inside the corpus — one work defines 四九天劫 as four bolts. Usable as decoration; not usable as inherited vocabulary.

dangerList.design: Quoted formulas and closed quality curves harvested from guide sites.
dangerList.whyNot: The sweep's clearest provenance failure. One refine-quality formula is sourced to three guides giving three different answers, and two of the pages carrying it have World of Warcraft alchemy text pasted mid-article. Another flagship number traces to a page opening 很高兴能够参与这个寻仙手游80装备属性问题集合的解答工作 — an AI-generated SEO aggregation, and the sole source for an entire design slot. The same ecosystem invents physical units (0.3μT) and chapter numbers for novels that do not contain them.

dangerList.design: 灵石 as both money and an emergency qi potion, crushed mid-fight.
dangerList.whyNot: You cannot forbid a power scalar and then let money be a power item: 中品 carries ten times the qi, so it is ten times the survival, and the currency stops being a currency. Note the discipline this needs — the mid-duel-crush scene is one web novel's device, but 灵石 as a cultivation consumable is bedrock across the corpus, and the tension is real even though the specific scene is not canon.

dangerList.design: Proportional reward distribution by personal contribution, and conscription with a hard outcome.
dangerList.whyNot: 凡人's 血色禁地 is the genre's most-documented 秘境 and its own text says both things: pills are distributed 按各派提供的靈药多少来按比例分配, which demands every participant keep an exact personal tally and trust it, and ten have nine conscripts find somewhere to hide and wait out the clock. The novel explains that an institution cannot punish an unwilling conscript. Both are real, and both are unusable as an agent loop.

dangerList.design: A global blacklist of who killed whom, feeding a bounty system with a permanent kill order.
dangerList.whyNot: Not because the mechanic is bad — it is genuinely canon-shaped and aimed at informants rather than killers, which is the better version — but because the escalation-incentive problem is the whole risk. 追杀令's reward pool goes to whoever supplies the head or the proof, which deliberately incentivises third parties; keep that shape, and never pair it with a world state that one defection permanently changes.

unresolved: Whether any shipped game has ever made the five-year / five-day collective-weakness window a recurring coordination substrate. One chapter of one novel states it verbatim and no game was found using it. Would settle it: the same pattern in three or more independent works, plus a patch-note sweep for 虚弱期 / 衰弱期 across cultivation titles. The entire top design slot rests on a single chapter until this is done.

Whether 战力 mispredicting outcomes is a genre property or one game's quirk. The only evidence is one player-reported match. Would settle it: instrumented win rate by 战力 band — no studio has published it and no one has run it. This is the cheapest and most useful thing we could measure.

Why 觅长生's three bodies diverge across a 20x range instead of tracking one number. The table transcribes correctly and the interpretation (a fake multi-body model) is arithmetically refuted — zero of fourteen rows match the claimed constant ratio. Nobody has published why. Would settle it: a designer interview, the game's own config, or a second game's stat table read the same way.

Whether a COSTED list of what a sect promises its members exists anywhere. The promised list is canon prose; the costed list is absent from every work surveyed. Would settle it: any 宗门 economy with per-member itemised costs — a search that has not been run, since every pass found the prose and stopped.

Whether the exchange RATE is ever contestable world state that a single agent can move reversibly. Posted 100 versus realised 110-130 is documented in three works and a computable bid lattice exists in one, but no game was found where an agent's own action visibly moves the rate and the log shows the mechanism. Would settle it: any live economy with a published spread history.

Whether non-age herb quality axes are common or rare. 年份 is dominant and two games have their own systems (品级 with 药力 1/3/9/36/180/1080; 鬼谷八荒's 品阶), so a single-variable gathering step would be our choice, not an inheritance. Would settle it: a count across twenty games' herb tables.

Whether 诛仙 the novel has no 天劫. The finding rests on absence from a chapter index, which is weak across 1.6M words. Would settle it: a full-text search of the novel. It matters because the claim is doing structural work — that the 2010 game added a four-tier ladder the novel does not have.

Whether 妖丹 as a two-sided engine (the beast cultivates with it, harvest is amputation) is ever shipped as a system rather than a plot beat. One novel states it. Would settle it: any shipped pet system where harvesting measurably reduces the resource's own growth rate.

Whether the 天人五衰's five members are ever enumerated consistently. One novel names three and its own commentary guesses the last two; a third novel uses a different five; the Buddhist 大五衰 is a different list again. Would settle it: a primary text, not a guide.

Whether 贡献点 non-convertibility is a genre feature. The only attestation is an AI-generated encyclopedia page, and one novel runs the internal 积分 as more valuable than 灵石 outright. Would settle it: any game's official text with a stated conversion prohibition between two currencies.

Whether the audience reads 三九/四九/六九/九九 as meaningful. It is a modern convention with an attested counter-definition inside the corpus and no reader survey exists. Would settle it: a survey, which nobody has run. Low stakes — treat the numbers as decoration and the names as free comprehension.

Whether the 鬼谷八荒 five-year re-entry ban after leaving a sect exists. One unreplicated secondary citation, named as an agent hazard, not corroborated by any of the guides that cover its promotion costs in detail. Would settle it: the game's own text.

Whether any shipped game has turned 仙人五衰 — the arrival rate described with no distribution attached — into a schedule an agent can plan around. Every source describes the frequency; none describes when the next one comes, which is what an agent would need. Would settle it: official patch notes stating a cadence.

critique:
# COMPLETENESS CRITIC — verification pass on the cultivation-game synthesis

I read the repo rule locally first: **verified verbatim.** `packages/features/progression/src/rules.ts:271-278` carries the exact quoted sentence ("A design with a power score has exactly one answer to 'who is stronger'…"), in a comment attached to `SKILLS` — eight independent skills with "NO single power scalar." The rule is real, it is load-bearing, and the synthesis's use of it is fair. Everything below is about the *genre evidence* the rule is being applied to.

---

## PART 1 — PROVENANCE FAILURES: claims that are wrong, misattributed, or resting on content farms

### 1.1 The single worst claim in the document: 云墟修仙录 is misquoted, and it carries Hard Constraint #2

The synthesis writes: *"云墟修仙录's official guide, from 金丹 onward every tribulation resolves on one line: 胜负只看一条：你的战力 ≥ 雷劫战力就成功，否则必败"* — and builds the design's most emphatic danger entry on it ("This is the purest instance of the failure in the entire sweep, and it ships").

**The game does not do this.** 云墟修仙录 is a 休闲/文字 Roguelike by 云墟仙途工作室 (the studio behind 养娃模拟器), TapTap-published, 10–20 minutes per run. Its own player-facing guide on the TapTap developer forum documents a **three-outcome tribulation with a published probability table** (tag: *documented*, player guide, not vendor text):

| 战力 as % of required | 成功率 | 死亡率 |
|---|---|---|
| 100% | 80% | 0% |
| 85% | 62% | 8% |
| 70% | 40% | 20% |
| <50% | 大概率死 | — |

Plus a purchasable talent **万劫雷池: 渡劫门槛降低20%**. That is a *probability surface over a ratio with a purchasable mitigation*, not a binary comparison. The quoted line is not in the game's text; it is a third-party forum paraphrase, and the synthesis attributes it to "official."

Consequences, in order of damage:
- **Hard Constraint #2 ("The tribulation may not be adjudicated by a threshold comparison")** is sourced to a misquotation. The claim itself is *still probably right* — but its evidence is now unusable, and the one piece of primary text I found that adjudicates a tribulation non-thresholdedly (see 2.1 below) makes the case better anyway. Re-source or delete.
- The synthesis's "at least six shipped games" damage count is unverified and the one game it names is not one of them.

The same game's guide also contains the **worst permanent-state-by-threshold mechanic in the whole sweep**, and the synthesis found a *softer* version of it and attributed it to 诛仙: *"心魔别超过 60… 心魔到 100 会触发正道通缉，下次出门就有一个大佬来砍你，战力比你高 2000，基本必死."* A hidden integer crossing 100 summons an adversary with a **+2000 power advantage** — a death sentence issued by a number the player was never told was load-bearing. ### 1.2 封神演义 does have a tribulation clause, and the synthesis's "no 三灾 at all and runs 1500 years" is wrong on the primary text

The synthesis's Hard Constraint #4 rests partly on: *"the three root traditions use incompatible tribulation cadences (封神 has no 三灾 at all and runs 1500 years; 凡人 runs 300/3000; 西游记 runs 500/1000/1500)."*

I pulled 封神演义 ch. 99 from ctext.org and Wikisource. The 敕 that opens the 封神臺 reads, verbatim:

> 「縱服氣煉形于島嶼，未曾斬卻三尸，**終歸五百年後之劫**；總抱真守一于玄關，若未超脫陽神，**難赴三千瑤池之約**。」

So 封神 states **500** and **3000** — and it gates them on **斬三尸 / 陽神 completion**, i.e. on *tasks performed*, not on a power value. It also states the enforcement rule explicitly: **「有功之日，循序而遷」** — promotion is by accumulated merit.

Three separate errors in one sentence:
- "no 三灾 at all" — **false**; the text has 劫, denominated.
- "runs 1500 years" — **unsupported**; the numbers the text gives are 500 and 3000.
- "no shared number to inherit" — the traditions are **closer** than the synthesis says (500 and 3000 appear in the synthesis's own 西游记 list), and what 封神 actually supplies is a *mechanism* the synthesis never extracted: a tribulation denominated in **completed deeds**, with a **merit-based promotion rule**. That is the anti-scalar tribulation, in 1590s fiction, in the root text the synthesis says it read.

And ch. 99 contains one more thing the synthesis treated as scenery: the **三百六十五位正神 roster, fully enumerated with offices**, ranked 八部 by 「劫运之轻重」 and 「资品之高下」, with **黄飞虎 given adjudication authority over all life/death transformation in the world** — 「凡应生死转化人神仙鬼，俱从东岳勘对方许施行」. That is a **fixed, published, enumerable, merit-assigned role table plus a single named adjudication office.** It is the genre's own anti-scalar, machine-checkable role-assignment system, and it is the direct ancestor of 洪荒's 封神榜. The synthesis used 封神 as *negative* evidence three times and never once as a source of a mechanism.

### 1.3 The LLM constraint layer: citations I could not match, and a counter-result the synthesis did not surface

The eight hard constraints are the load-bearing wall of the whole design. I could not match **arXiv:2609.02580** (11 buyers / 11 sellers / published price grid), **arXiv:2509.09071** (sellers systematically overconcede), or **arXiv:2604.11840** (5 agents, 15 turns, 314/315, 0/135 with reasoning enabled) to the findings attributed to them, nor to a *Nature Human Behaviour 2025* paper by that title. I am not calling them fabricated — I am reporting that **the findings as stated are not what the literature I can reach says**, and that matters because three of the constraints are stated with the grammar of measurement (specific counts, specific percentages) and the brief explicitly warns that a number in measurement grammar transfers unearned trust.

What the literature actually says, and it cuts both ways:

- **arXiv:2512.09254, "The Illusion of Rationality"** (NegotiationArena; Buyer–Seller, Multi-turn Ultimatum, Resource Exchange; 120 games per role per model, 6 opponents, seller valuation 40 / buyer 60, ZOPA 20; gap analysis 10–90, 20 self-play sims each). Its central finding is **not** "no convergence observed." It is that models **diverge into distinct model-specific equilibria** rather than converging, that proposals **collapse onto salient magnitudes** (multiples of 5, Sankey flow), and that there are **stable dominance rankings across models** (Gemini 2.5 Pro > Claude 4.5 Sonnet > GPT-4.1 > GPT-4.1 mini; e.g. 83.35 mean payoff as proposer vs GPT-4.1 mini). The anchoring finding is **more useful to the design than what the synthesis reported** — it says posted prices will cluster on round numbers, which is an argument *for* a book, not against one. And the **model-tier dominance finding is a system requirement the synthesis never considered**: if our agent fleet is heterogeneous by model, the player's model strength is a hidden advantage in exactly the coordinates the tribulation is supposed to be immune to.
- **arXiv:2506.00073** (100 real products, buyer budget β, seller wholesale cost). The concession effect is real but **conditioned on budget**, and it runs through **budget disclosure**: buyers overpay above retail under high β; sellers concede below wholesale; "as budgets increase… models tend to accept sellers' proposed prices once they fall below budget." The synthesis's "LLM **sellers** systematically overconcede" attributes a buyer-shaped effect to the wrong actor and drops the precondition.
- **arXiv:2603.18563** — a **direct counter-result**. It proves LLM agents instantiated as **Bayesian posterior samplers are guaranteed to converge to near-Nash in infinitely repeated games**, instantiated with Qwen 3.5-27B across five environments including the Prisoner's Dilemma. So "LLMs never converge" is **not a law**; it is a property of *off-the-shelf* agents under specific protocols. The synthesis hardens it into an absolute design constraint without noting the theorem pointing the other way. That is a confidence the evidence does not support.
- One more, lower-confidence, and included because it is *directly* on the synthesis's best design idea: a preprint-server study (clawrXiv 2026.00007 — **treat as unverified, the numbers are suspiciously clean**) reports 1,024 agents / 16 commodities / 50,000 rounds, where **continuous double auctions converge to within 3.2% of competitive equilibrium (median 847 rounds, >94% efficiency by round 500) and posted-price markets do not (11.7% persistent deviation, sellers overpricing 8–15%)**. It also names the failure mode the synthesis's "publish depth" slot does not mention at all: **collusive convergence in thin markets** — under 8 agents per side per commodity, HHI > 2500 in 73% of runs, with **no communication whatsoever**, pure mutual best-response. For a fleet of 10–50 agents, **the book's failure mode is a silent cartel, not non-convergence.** That belongs in the design as a stated hazard with a mitigation (a minimum population per instrument, or a randomised tick).

The synthesis's *conclusion* — no haggling surfaces, no free-form agent negotiation — survives. Its *citations* do not, and the cartesian one is missing.

**Two things follow that the synthesis does not say.** First, its danger list warns only against *"a claim with NO number but written in the grammar of a measurement."* The far more dangerous shape, and the one I actually hit, is the reverse: **a fabricated number in perfectly measured grammar**, which passes every sanity check the synthesis lists. ## PART 2 — SELF-CONTRADICTIONS

**2.1 "境界 is not a scalar" vs. the fact that 境界 is a total order over persons.** The synthesis's structural argument is: *"品阶 sits on the OBJECT and 境界 on the PERSON, which is exactly why the genre never needed a power number."* This is a non-sequitur and the synthesis half-knows it — its own first inventory row asks *"Does any rung of our ladder order two cultivators against each other? If yes, the whole design is the thing the repo rule forbids."* 境界 **does** order two cultivators against each other; that is what a ladder is. Putting a rank on the object instead of the person does not dissolve the scalar, it splits it in two and makes the one on the person harder to remove. The repo rule is satisfied by *capability gates*, which the synthesis proposes in the same paragraph and then does not apply consistently. This contradiction is load-bearing because the whole no-scalar doctrine is argued from it.

**2.2 "Strong majority convention" and "convention-free" in the same row.** The exchange-rate row says the 100:1 step *"is a strong majority convention many works violate and is free to discard,"* and then, in the same row, lists it as *documented at 100:1, 1000:1, 10:1 and roughly 5/5/6 across works* and concludes it is *"convention-free."* Those cannot both be load-bearing. The correct statement is: **the four-tier ladder is canon (confirmed, including 忘语's 低阶/中阶/高阶/超阶 with a parallel element axis); the step is a free variable and every surveyed value is defensible.** Two shipped games I found use a **linear** step, not geometric: 烟雨江湖's talisman prices run 200文 / 270文 / 340文 (+70 per tier), and its 任督二脉 真气 requirement ladder runs 400, 520, 640, 760, 900, 1080, 1200, 1360, 1520, 1720 (+120 per stage, 9 stages). Ten data points in one game. **Take the linear step.** It is also the only step an agent can plan against.

**2.3 寿元: cut in the inventory, protected in the canon map.** The canon map says *"寿元 is a CONSEQUENCE of 境界, not the scalar — the thing that must not exist is the realm ladder, not the lifespan."* The inventory says **SHOULD_CUT**, open question "none worth asking." Hard Constraint #4 says no year-denominated wall clock may be a gate. Three positions, one system. Resolve it: cut lifespan as a **deadline**, keep 寿元 as a **resource that buys actions** (see 3.7), which is the version 云墟修仙录 actually shipped — **50000 灵石 for 50 years**, an auction, and the game's own forum complains the auction is timed to arrive when you can't afford it. That is a year-denominated *purchase*, not a year-denominated *gate*, and it is the only lifespan mechanic in my sweep that an agent can act on.

**2.4 "The genre's structural defence is capacity-typed place grades" is asserted while the evidence for it is a scalar.** The openDesignSpace entry on capacity-typed places says the concept is *"already half-built"* and that the official guide stating the capacity rule *"also carries a power-scalar fallback clause for who wins a contested vein, which is what the pass read first."* A design whose supporting evidence is the clause the author discarded is not half-built. Meanwhile the actual anti-scalar instance in that domain is *not* place grades at all — it is 打工修仙记's 布阵, where the only deployable array is 聚灵阵, its effect is **灵气浓度 → 修炼速度**, and the developer-facing post calls it **过于鸡肋，不推荐**. That is a shipped capacity-typed output that produces no power number, acknowledged as weak by its own designer. Use that, not the vein.

**2.5 "Nobody has taken it" is asserted four times in openDesignSpace, and it is false at least three times.** The synthesis says the artifact-as-claim, the comprehension-record, the calendar-as-pacing, the contribution-as-help, and the peak-as-liability have all been left untaken. Checking:

A stat that is a *percentage of a percentage* is how a game rebuilds a scalar out of four small ones.
